scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --config wrangler.jsonc && react-router typegen && tsc -b
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/seed.ts && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc --file .wrangler/seed.sql
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.db:seed:staging: node scripts/seed.ts && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging --file .wrangler/seed.sql
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging pnpm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging && wrangler deploy
